description:
CLI and web runner for BuddyAI agents, like Google ADK.

        Produces a single executable JAR: buddyai-runner.jar

        Install:
        cp target/buddyai-runner.jar ~/.buddyai/
        sudo cp src/main/scripts/buddyai /usr/local/bin/

        Usage (from any agent project directory):
        buddyai agent run        → interactive terminal chat
        buddyai agent web        → browser UI on :3579
